column1: # Counts of eighteen words in 54 texts that China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology published on its own site (www.miit.gov.cn) from 2023 to 2026 on computing, AI, electronics and telecom (plans, notices and calls for projects, with their annexes and the ministry's own explanations): one row per saved text. Seventeen of the word columns were made by one script on Nov 23, 2026; the last column, 占比, was added on Nov 25, 2026 by the same reading of the same 54 saved texts, when every other cell was counted again with the same result. Three texts, the annexes of the ministry's 2026 call for green computing facilities, are saved as .wps files whose saver's text holds only its own header; on Nov 25, 2026 their rows were counted again, by the same reading, in the text LibreOffice makes of each saved file (before, each row gave 148 characters and no word). Each text is read with all spacing removed (a PDF's line breaks split words); for a saved page whose plain text is shorter than 400 characters the page itself is read without its markup. Columns: the saved id; the characters read; then the number of times each word stands: 国产 (home-made; not counted where 业 follows, as in 我国产业), 自主可控, 安全可靠, 芯片 (chip), 算力芯片, 国产算力, 国产化, 本国产品, 信创, 英伟达 (Nvidia), 替代, 不低于 (not less than), 比例 (share), the percent sign in its two forms, 算力, 安全 and 占比 (share of a total). What the rows show: 本国产品, 信创 and 英伟达 stand in none of the 54 texts; 国产 stands 6 times in 5 of them and 自主可控 5 times in 4. The count in OFFICIAL_RECORD.md, section 2.1, is of the three share words: 不低于 stands 18 times, 比例 9 times and 占比 29 times, 56 in all (the sums of those three columns), in 13 of the 54 texts (43 in 10 texts before the three annexes were read; they add 比例 twice and 占比 eleven times, all in the annexes' rating indicators and forms: the share of renewable power, of a user's power consumption and of racks in use). None of the 56 stands in one sentence with 国产, 本国 or 芯片, or within 50 characters of one: the nearest of those words is 85 characters away (spacing not counted). What the table is not: a count of words, not a reading of the texts (the entry of OFFICIAL_RECORD.md quotes what they say); not every text the ministry published; and a text that sets no share says nothing of measures that are not published.
